description_expanded: Just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands of 30A, Sunny Seagrove offers the ultimate beachside escape in the charming Gulf Mist community of Seagrove Beach. With 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and space for up to 10 guests, this beautifully updated coastal cottage blends laid-back elegance with everyday comfort and convenience. Enjoy peaceful mornings on the front porch, shaded afternoons under the backyard pergola, and the luxury of being just 0.1 miles from not one—but two—beach access points directly across the street. The first floor of this two-story retreat welcomes you with an airy open-concept layout, where crisp white shiplap walls, navy accents, and natural textures create a calm and inviting space. The living area includes a cozy linen sofa and two armchairs arranged around a mantle and flat-screen TV—perfect for family movie nights. A 10-seat dining table anchors the heart of the home, while the adjacent kitchen offers stainless-steel appliances, stone countertops, and a two-stool breakfast bar. This level also features a guest bedroom with two full beds and a shared bathroom, along with a queen sleeper sofa in the living area for added flexibility. Upstairs, guests will find two spacious king bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom. The Primary Suite features a luxurious layout with a walk-in shower, soaking tub, and balcony access with treetop views—ideal for enjoying a quiet cup of coffee or an evening breeze. The second king suite offers a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo, giving everyone their own space to unwind. Throughout the home, coastal artwork and thoughtful touches complete the relaxed, upscale feel. Outdoor living is a highlight at Sunny Seagrove. The large backyard patio features a white trellis pergola, alfresco dining space, a cushioned sectional, and a gas grill—perfect for lazy lunches or evening gatherings. The front porch includes additional seating, while the upstairs balcony overlooks the treetops and pool area. Guests have access to a refreshing community pool just a short walk away, nestled behind white picket fences and framed by palm trees. With two beach access points just across the street, you can have your toes in the sand in under two minutes. Walk to beloved local favorites like Café Thirty-A, Angelina’s Pizzeria, and Prema Organic Café—all just minutes from your door. Four complimentary adult bikes make it easy to cruise to Seaside or explore the scenic trails that wind through 30A. Whether you're grabbing morning coffee, enjoying dinner out, or strolling the shoreline at sunset, Sunny Seagrove is your home base for unforgettable beach days and easygoing nights. First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Kitchen, Dining, Guest Bedroom with Two Full Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo. Second Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Balcony Access and Private Bathroom with Walk-In-Shower + Soaking Tub, King Bedroom with Shower/Tub Combo.
